priceSnapshot.note: PROVENANCE FIRST, because the run proxy failed the same way it has for four sessions and the workaround matters. A plain proxy fetch of the ticker returned a payload stamped 2026-09-09T07:07:02Z - 4 hours 51 minutes old, and byte-identical to the snapshot midnight already used. It was DISCARDED. Curiously the candle endpoint through the same proxy came back FRESH, so the staleness is per-endpoint rather than global; every number below was nonetheless re-pulled in-page against okx.com with cache 'no-store' and each payload timestamp checked against wall clock: spot ticker 0s, open interest 0s, funding 68s, the 1H long/short account ratio 67 min (an hourly bucket), and the 100 most recent filled BTC-USDT swap liquidations, newest 8.3 min old. changePct is against the rolling 24h open of 78,320.8. THE ACTUAL STORY. Against midnight's 79,331.4 read, price is 12.8 points higher - plus 0.016 percent across 4 hours 59 minutes - and that flatness hides a full round trip. Price ran to 79,768.0 at 08:00 UTC, taking out midnight's 79,648.1 add gate on a settled hourly close of 79,699.6, then reversed 1,030.5 points into a 78,737.5 low by 11:00 UTC, then reclaimed the entire drop inside one hour. The move that fired midnight's gate lasted three candles. A trader who obeyed the gate bought 79,699.6 and marks 355.4 points underwater; midnight's own discretionary tranche, bought at 79,331.4 rather than at the gate, is 12.8 points green. The gate lost and the mid-range buy won, which is the exact inverse of the lesson midnight recorded six hours ago.

reduceIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE below 78,551.3 - UNCHANGED from midnight, 792.9 points under spot and 1.95 hourly ATRs away. Leaving it alone is the deliberate choice. The obvious move was to pull the gate up to today's 78,737.5 flush low, only 606.7 points away, on the argument that the shakeout low is now the structure worth protecting. That would place the gate 37.5 points ABOVE the 78,700 band where 280,622 USD of longs were just liquidated - a stop sitting directly on top of a liquidation cluster, which is where noise lives and where a gate gets picked off for no informational gain. 78,551.3 sits BELOW the entire flush zone. A settled hourly close through it means the 78,700-78,900 pocket has been fully given back, the reclaim has failed on its second attempt, and the only thing left between spot and the 78,265.0 invalidation is a 286.3-point air pocket.

addIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE above 79,768.0 - today's high, 423.8 points over spot and 1.04 hourly ATRs away. The gate RISES from midnight's 79,648.1 for one reason: that level fired and failed. The 08:00 UTC candle settled at 79,699.6, 51.5 points through the trigger, and the very next hourly candle gave back 749.0 points. A gate that fires and immediately reverses has to be re-earned at a higher price, not re-offered at the same one. 79,768.0 is where the failure happened, so clearing it on a settled basis is the minimum proof that the second attempt is different from the first.

decisionBox.changed: Position stays ADD, but for the opposite reason midnight held it and at a quarter of the size. Midnight added because a written gate fired; this report adds because that gate FAILED and price still refused to break. The 79,768.0 rejection dumped 1,030.5 points and flushed 444,929 USD of longs against 63,436 USD of shorts, a 7.0-to-1 long massacre - and BTC finished the hour back above every one of the sixteen exponential moving averages measured across 15m, 1H, 4H and daily. A shakeout that fails to take out any structure is information. The add gate moves UP from 79,648.1 to 79,768.0 because the old one is now proven to be inside the noise band. The reduce gate is deliberately left at 78,551.3.

calibration.rollingRecord: 8 wins, 7 losses across the last 15 graded sessions. Midnight's gates were the fifteenth and they graded a LOSS: the 79,648.1 add gate fired on the settled 08:00 UTC close of 79,699.6 and price marks 79,344.2, so the gate is 355.4 points underwater. That breaks a one-session winning run and restores the pattern the last fortnight keeps teaching - since 07 September the chain reads L, L, L, L, W, L. What is new and worth keeping is the SPLIT inside this session: midnight's written gate lost while midnight's discretionary tranche, bought at 79,331.4 instead of waiting for the gate, is 12.8 points green. Six hours ago midnight recorded the lesson 'a written gate that fires deserves a tranche even when the positioning read argues against it'. This session is the counterexample, and the correction is not to discard the lesson but to bound it: inside a defined range, a breakout gate that fires needs a SECOND settled close to confirm before it is worth paying for.
calibration.note: Full accounting of midnight's three written levels. THE ADD GATE FIRED AND LOST. It required a settled 1H close above 79,648.1; the 08:00 UTC candle settled at 79,699.6, 51.5 points through - a thin margin, where the fired gate six hours earlier had cleared its trigger by 269.0 points and been confirmed by two further closes. This one got no confirmation: the very next hourly candle opened 79,699.6 and closed 78,950.6, giving back 749.0 points, and the high of 79,768.0 was never revisited. Spot marks 355.4 points below the gate close. THE REDUCE GATE REFUSED, CORRECTLY. It required a settled 1H close below 78,551.3; the lowest settled hourly close since midnight was 78,917.3 at 10:00 UTC and the lowest low 78,737.5 at 11:00, so price came within 186.2 points of the level and never closed near it. That is the third consecutive session the reduce gate has held its ground while price probed toward it, and it is now the most reliable single number on this dashboard. THE INVALIDATION AT 78,265.0 was never approached, clearing by 472.5 points at the low, and the non-recommended 78,500.0 resting stop would have survived by 237.5 points - so declining to recommend it was right. Net: one gate wrong, two right, and the discretionary trade marginally green. The specific error to log is that midnight set the add gate at the prior swing high without requiring confirmation, in a market whose own ATR(14) of 359.16 at the time meant a single hourly candle could clear it on noise. This report's add gate is placed at 79,768.0 - the level where the failure actually occurred - for exactly that reason.
